stack_scope: Context apply and inverse restore exact known previous tree incl #926 and #936; this stack was not natively built for this receipt.
scope: Synchronous thread-local net live allocator requests; successful realloc uses new size minus old. Prebuilt strict JournalProjection and its synthetic inputs are outside the meter. Pure in-process requested-call renderer, no model responses or execution. Separate existing transcript and HTTP tests cover executed response visibility, reset, nested/auxiliary cases, and other legitimate behavior. No process PSS measured. Negative mark (-1) means the 2-pass empty control never reaches that marker.

reproduction.runner:
set -eu
here=$PWD
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_REFERENCE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_SESSION_STORAGE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
for arm in stock owner; do (
 cd "$arm"
 c=crates/proteus-core/src
 path=$c/app_server/transcript/journal/tests.rs
 for f in "$path" "$c/lib.rs"; do cp "$f" "$f.w332-backup"; done
 cp "$here/meter.rs" "$c/w332_alloc.rs"
 printf '\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod w332_alloc;\n' >> "$c/lib.rs"
 cat "$here/probe.rs" >> "$path"
 cargo test --offline --locked --release -p proteus-core --lib --no-run -j 4 >"$here/$arm.build.log" 2>&1
 grep -F "($here/$arm/crates/proteus-core)" "$here/$arm.build.log"
 bin=$(sed -nE 's/.*Executable unittests src\/lib.rs \(([^)]+)\).*/\1/p' "$here/$arm.build.log")
 cp "$bin" "$here/$arm-tests"
 for f in "$path" "$c/lib.rs"; do mv "$f.w332-backup" "$f"; done
 rm "$c/w332_alloc.rs"
 cd crates/proteus-core
 mkdir -p "$here/$arm.wire"
 W332_WITNESS_DIR="$here/$arm.wire" "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::transcript::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.test.log" 2>&1
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::http::tests::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.api.log" 2>&1
); done
reproduction.runner_environment: Supply the matching local inert reference and session-storage fixtures from the existing Core test setup to the runner. Both native binaries are standalone stock/candidate, not full-app releases.
